decisions.rationale: cotest is the joint conformance harness itself: it has no production build and ships no binary that runs outside a test run, so the test-kit is an ordinary dependency of its library rather than a dev-dependency of something else.
soland-test-support is an unpublished integration-test fixture crate, consumed only by soland-server dev-dependencies. Its shared signing fixtures are not reachable from production builds.

cotest-test-support is the unpublished SDK-only provisioning and wire-fixture harness used by Cotest test runs. Its deterministic signing material is not consumed by a production service; the package graph gate keeps implementation crates out of this tooling edge.
